title: Enoughness learned through gratitude
subtitle: For the appetite that notices lack faster than mercy
description: These readings train the eye to see given mercy before the appetite can rename life as shortage.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Gratitude restores Naam by teaching the heart to recognize gift before complaint.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Count a mercy slowly enough that wanting loses its first word.

evidence.coreClaim: This path joins gratitude and contentment so lack no longer gets to narrate the whole day.
evidence.turn: Enoughness becomes believable when mercy is noticed as received, not imagined as missing.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before asking for more, honor one gift with attention and restraint.
